title: wss-guide: 'patches' terminology for ChatPresenceEvent not from spec
description: The guide calls ChatPresenceEvent 'patches'. The spec defines the optional-field semantics (absent=unchanged, null=cleared) but does not use the word 'patch'. Using 'patch' implies RFC 7396 or JSON Patch semantics, which are not referenced. Use 'partial update' or 'delta' instead.
